name: Országgyűlés (National Assembly)
notes: 199 seats, 2026-2030 term. Party counts from the Hungarian News Agency's report of the inaugural sitting (9 May 2026: Tisza 141, Fidesz 44, KDNP 8, Mi Hazánk 6), the 2026 election result of the National Election Office; later changes (four Fidesz national-list resignations, each replaced from the Fidesz list) leave the split unchanged. Cross-checked against the hu.wikipedia list of 2026-2030 MPs on 2026-11-04. Fidesz and KDNP sit as one group (52). parlament.hu answers scripts with a CAPTCHA and data.ipu.org with a Cloudflare check (neither bypassed), so no official member list could be read directly; the 13 nationality spokespersons have no vote and are not counted.
